about: Field Cogitator design data. `language` summarises the design language (token groups in src/language/tokens.css, layout numbers in src/language/layout.ts). `elements.sections` lists the Elements view's sections and entries in page order; the Elements page renders from this list, so a new primitive needs an entry here and a renderer there. Everything is a Proposal on Next until the user approves it (next-track.json).
source: D4 step 2, design language (2026-11-22), extracted from Direction D

language.scope: An element with .fc-cg and .light or .dark; macOS is the base layer, [data-platform="windows"] the Windows layer, [data-text="large"] large text (1.25×).

groups.title: Colour
groups.note: Semantic names; status colours always come with a shape (edge or icon).

groups.title: State mixes
groups.note: Mixes of ink or accent, so every theme gets them; Windows presses with a fill, macOS with a filter.

platforms.windows: Segoe UI Variable, 14 px working text

groups.title: Spacing
groups.note: 4 px grid with D's half steps (6, 10, 14, 18).

rowsInView.note: Source list rows without group headings; Iron Wardens (4 headings, 13 rows) fits on both.

platforms.mac: 6 px controls, 9 / 12 px floating, 12 px window
platforms.windows: 4 px controls, 8 px floating and window

groups.title: Elevation
groups.note: Only floating things are raised: pill, helper box, popovers, menus, palette, dialogs (no-card rule).

groups.title: Motion
groups.note: Layout changes 0.2 s, small feedback 0.12 s; zero with reduced motion.

platforms.mac: 2 px accent ring inside the control
platforms.windows: 2 px ink ring 1 px outside the control

groups.title: Layout
collapseOrder: Below 1358 px: helper panel becomes the floating box
Below 1322 px: floating box becomes the pill

entries.title: Window frame and title row
entries.from: Direction D; Windows frame new (Battle Augur RK-03 style)
entries.summary: macOS: traffic lights in the sidebar's top row, 12 px corners. Windows: no menu bar; the dataset switcher moves up into the title row, Windows' own caption buttons (46 px, the header's height) sit at the far right, 8 px corners.

entries.title: Sidebar item
entries.summary: 28 px rows on the surface paper. Active (the source shown in the list) is the selection tint; current (the open entry) is bold with an accent icon, no fill.

entries.title: Source group heading
entries.summary: Caption size, weight 600, sentence case, the count in regular weight; a chevron folds the group. Space above it separates groups, no hairline.

entries.title: Source row
entries.summary: Glyph, name, changed dot, cost and diagnostic in fixed columns under the column heads; the status edge anchors the row. Costs in tabular figures, right-aligned.

entries.title: Filter field
entries.summary: A quiet filled field (hover fill), the focus ring inside it; Esc clears it.

entries.title: Buttons
entries.from: Direction D; disabled and Windows pressed states new
entries.summary: Primary (accent), quiet (hover fill), small (in rows), ghost (toolbar, icon + label + key) and icon buttons.

entries.title: Segmented control
entries.summary: Two scopes (This entry, Dataset) with counts; the selected one is the pane colour with a thumb shadow.

entries.title: Keycap
entries.summary: Micro size, hairline border, muted; macOS glyphs, Windows names.

entries.title: Breadcrumbs and page toolbar
entries.summary: Source / entry, then status text and the ghost buttons Focus and Source.

entries.title: Page title and backlinks
entries.summary: Kind glyph, title, backlinks as mentions; an entry without text shows its key in mono with a suggestion tag.

entries.title: Layer chip
entries.summary: Selection tint, accent text, micro weight 600: marks which layer a source or value comes from.

entries.title: Tags, mentions and the peek
entries.summary: Tags are hues mixed into the paper; a mention is an accent chip with ↗ that opens its entry; hover or focus shows the peek popover. A broken reference is red mono with a wavy underline.

entries.title: Property row
entries.summary: Label column (icon + label, muted) and a value cell that tints on hover; the properties block ends with a hairline.

entries.title: Statement block
entries.summary: Mono keyword, then the value; a chevron folds children; a flagged block gets a 2 px status edge and a faint tint while its diagnostic is open.

entries.title: Helper pill
entries.summary: The helper collapsed: counts by kind with their icons; click brings the box back.

entries.title: Floating helper box
entries.summary: This page's issues, suggestions and actions in the one raised object over the page margin; collapse to the pill or expand to the panel.

entries.title: Panel tabs and resize edge
entries.summary: Issues, Suggestions, Properties; the active tab is the press fill; issue counts in the error badge. The panel's left edge lights up in the accent when it can be dragged.

entries.title: Issue row
entries.summary: Status edge, message with code, where in mono; selected shows the fix as a primary small button (and Go to when elsewhere); done shows Undo.

entries.title: Empty states
entries.summary: One muted line with what is empty and the way out (Clear filter); a check in OK green when nothing is wrong.

entries.title: Exit focus and focus toggles
entries.summary: In focus mode the list header carries the window controls and Exit focus with its key; outside it, an icon button enters focus.

entries.title: / insert menu
entries.summary: Statements valid at the cursor with their syntax in mono; ↵ inserts the selected one.

entries.title: Command palette (⌘K)
entries.summary: Search entries and run commands: entries with glyph, key and cost, commands with their key; a dialog, so it floats with the dialog elevation.

entries.title: Context menu
entries.summary: Right-click or ⇧F10 on a row: verbs with targets, shortcuts as muted text, destructive last in error red.

entries.title: Large text (1.25×)
entries.from: New rule for Direction D's rows
entries.summary: Working text at 1.25×: rows grow from a minimum height, names wrap instead of truncating, costs keep their right-aligned column, property labels wrap.

screens.title: Start window
screens.summary: No dataset open: app actions in the sidebar, recent datasets (title, folder, DKLPO version, layers on / total, last opened, status edge), a drop target. The selected row opens a second line with the last check and Open / Show in Finder / Remove from the list, or for a missing dataset Locate… / Remove from the list.
workflows: Open a recent dataset: select (click or ↑ ↓), Return or double-click; progress shows reading files, compiling and checking with counts; Esc cancels
Remove a recent dataset: ⌘⌫ (Delete on Windows) or the row action; Undo in the footer (⌘Z)
Missing dataset: Locate… points the row at its new folder, or remove it
Open folder… / Open file… / drop a folder or archive; a problem shows the open-errors dialog
Convert from XML data…: pick a folder of .gst / .cat files; the steps run with counts and the new dataset opens
First run: the empty state offers the three actions and the sample dataset

screens.title: Open errors
screens.summary: A sheet (macOS) or dialog with a footer band (Windows) over the start window: what happened, the folder, the choices as verbs; the primary takes Return, Cancel takes Esc.
workflows: Not a dataset: Convert… (XML data files found), Choose another folder…, Cancel
Newer DKLPO version: Open read-only (what the newer version added shows as source text, nothing saved) or Cancel
Files that do not parse: Open anyway (the files open as source text with their errors; their entries are left out) or Cancel
Folder not writable: Open read-only, Save as… elsewhere, or Cancel
